data.description:
## Description

**What**: Run audit-review-defenses.sh against plugins/dso/**/tests/ and tests/ subtrees and verify each REVIEW-DEFENSE annotates a test-context concern.

**Why**: SC-3 requires test-file defenses to be verified against test context specifically.

**Scope**: For each finding: (a) test-red and genuinely RED → leave, (b) test-non-obvious and assertion genuinely non-obvious → leave, (c) production-context-in-test → rewrite or remove, (d) RED test now passes and was promoted to GREEN → remove RED defense.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every test-file REVIEW-DEFENSE classified still-defended in test context is left intact
- Every test-file REVIEW-DEFENSE classified stale (promoted RED, production-in-test) is removed or rewritten
- Re-running audit-review-defenses.sh against test files shows zero stale test defenses
- docs/findings/epic-5018-64ce-todo-sweep.md test-defense section has one row per finding
- Pre-existing test suite still passes
